boundary: If the notice carried only an internal reference or the performance note without a national tax identifier resolvable to a named employee, Moderate (3) would be right; the unmasked government tax ID sent irreversibly to five external organizations makes it High (4).
note: The audit marks fact_layer 'missed' (the key's format as a Portuguese national tax reference) with moves_level true toward 4, and favoured_level 4 equals gold. The assessor names the identifier but treats it as an ordinary personnel reference and calls the data 'limited in scope', so the under-registered government-ID nature is what keeps the level at 3.
